excerpt: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE where AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces.
Already paying for Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, or MiniMax? Bring your existing API keys and use them directly in stagewise.
Connect self-hosted models via Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible endpoints... Full control, zero external API calls.
stagewise Account — The fastest way to start. Access a large library of pre-configured models through the managed inference service. No API keys needed.
Multiple workspaces — Connect several project folders at once so agents can work across your full stack
Diff review — Accept, reject, or undo every agent edit with full inline diffs
Before the agent writes real code, use design previews to iterate on visual changes.
For changes across multiple files, open the dedicated Diff Review page. It provides: A scrollable list of every modified file, Side-by-side diff view
Undo — Roll back all changes from a specific agent action. Redo — Reapply changes you previously undid
Select elements visually — Click on elements to attach them as agent context
Preview your app — Run your dev server and see the result in stagewise
Debug visually — The agent takes screenshots and inspects what users see
@mention files — Attach a workspace file so the agent reads it immediately. @mention tabs — Attach a browser tab so the agent sees what you're looking at
Skills are SKILL.md files that give the agent structured instructions for specific tasks. They teach the agent project-specific patterns, workflows, and constraints.
Invoke skills explicitly with slash commands. Type / in the chat to see available commands from your skills and plugins.
GitHub: Repository access, issues, pull requests, actions. Supabase: Database queries, edge functions, migrations
Figma — Access Figma designs, real-time selection monitoring
Shell access — Run shell commands, scripts, and package managers
stagewise supports multiple agent instances running in parallel. Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
When you connect a workspace, stagewise generates a WORKSPACE.md file in .stagewise/. This is the primary way the agent understands your project at a high level
Each provider is configured independently. A typical setup: Anthropic → Official API (your key); OpenAI → stagewise Account; Google → Custom endpoint
Skip authentication entirely by configuring BYOK for every provider you use. No requests go through the stagewise managed service
stagewise supports multiple API styles: OpenAI-compatible chat completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI.
Download the stagewise agentic IDE for macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows (64-bit), or Linux.
The agent can read and edit files, run shell commands, interact with browser tabs via CDP, and orchestrate complex multi-step workflows.
Reverse-engineer any website's components, style systems, and color palettes
IDE integration to view and apply code changes in your favorite editor
Work with a coding agent that has full access to your tab's console and debugger
Connect any of the following subscriptions with a single API key to unlock all models the provider offers directly inside stagewise.
Choose the editor used for opening files, keep the app awake while agents work, and customize notification sounds.
Hobby Free — Limited access to 3 standard models (Default, Quick, Smart)
SSO with OIDC and SAML; Provisioning with SCIM; Optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud
